QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] The Fountain of Reflection
QuestInfo.0: Rino says she will guide you safely through the Extinction Zone. You should see what your traveling companion, Kao, has to say about this offer.
QuestInfo.1: Kao has a more pressing agenda than traveling safely beyond the Vanishing Journey. The Temple Keeper hopes to recover the memories they lost at any cost. Perhaps Rino knows the way to the Fountain of Reflection?
QuestInfo.2: Rino knows how to reach the Fountain of Reflection. She says she'll take Kao there while you gather the necessary materials to tame your own Flame Bird.

0.msg: A safe way through the Extinction Zone...? I have more important things to worry about than getting out of here. I have to recover my lost memories. No matter how dangerous the path...

1.msg: Perhaps this is where we part ways.

2.msg: #b(Kao seems adamant. Maybe you should talk to Rino about the Fountain of Reflection.)#k

yes.0: Rino might know something. But maybe not... She...

no.0: To recover my lost memories... I need to find the Fountain of Reflection...

0.msg: The Fountain of Reflection... I know the way there. But why do you ask? I thought you two were just passing through.

1.msg: #bKao came here to find their memories.#k

2.msg: I see. I can escort Kao to the Fountain of Reflection, but first, I'll need your help.

3.msg: There's only one way past the flames of extinction, and that's over them, on the back of a Flame Bird. The Flame Birds are mysterious creatures that live only here.

4.msg: You can ride them, but you'll need a few things first... I only have enough supplies to tame two birds, so you'll have to get your own.

npc.0: But for some reason... I think she is...
